label: token right after an early "b" (original phase, t=2..5)
explanation: Fires in the original (input) phase on the step immediately after a "b" was input, when that b sits at positions 1-4 (t=2..5). Strongest (up to max) at t=4 after a b at position 3, and usually larger when the b is preceded by another b-step activation (b b x). Activation decays over the following 1-2 steps (weaker tail when prev2_tok is b), which accounts for most missed activations along with a diffuse low-magnitude background (~20% of mass) on other early original steps. Precision ~0.96, ~81% of activation mass. Does not fire at t=0/1, after t>=6 (b late in the sequence), on the delimiter (rare, weak) or anywhere in the copy phase, and is independent of the current input token identity.
